facts.title: StacklyUI — Animated React components that ship
facts.description: A beautifully animated, accessible React component library. Copy-paste or install — built on Tailwind and Motion, tuned for light and dark.

research.name: StacklyUI
research.note: Animated React components on Radix, Tailwind and Motion, themed from four OKLCH tokens and installed through a shadcn registry.
unverified: The component source is public in the MIT repository soumyajiitt/stacklyui (linked from the site); that repository has not yet been researched as its own candidate.
